name: Other money identified thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Money other than tax (damage to the state, civil claims filed) identified or claimed in investigations based on whistleblower information, whether or not recovered; breakdown item= says which.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-ltu1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-ltu1 (Lithuanian Prosecutor's Office reports). Companion to taxes_assessed_attributable and collections_attributable.

name: Appeals of award determinations
definition: Appeals of whistleblower award determinations (denials or amounts) filed with a court or appeal body in a period or to date, as the source counts them.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (GAO-11-683: more than 20 Tax Court appeals of IRS award denials by 2011).

name: Award applications admitted
definition: Reward applications an authority formally admitted for consideration (e.g. Hungarian GVH 'befogadott kérelem'), as opposed to all inquiries or applications received.
notes: proposed by research:uk-europe. Proposed for the Hungarian GVH informant reward; could instead be a breakdown of award_applications_received.

name: Award applications received
definition: Applications or requests for a reward filed by whistleblowers with the programme in a period (distinct from tips).
notes: proposed by research:international. Slovakia (requests for a reward to the Whistleblower Protection Office), Lithuania (requests for a reward for valuable information).

name: Average reward per paid claim
definition: Average reward paid per approved application or rewarded case over a period, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1 (ACRC reports print it every year).

name: Award claims denied
definition: Award claims or applications denied or rejected in a period (final determinations).

name: Award claims received
definition: Applications for a whistleblower award (e.g. SEC/CFTC Form WB-APP) received by the programme in a period, as the source counts them.
notes: proposed by research:sec-cftc. Distinct from tips_received (tips) and claims_closed (decided claims). Proposed by sec-cftc pass.

name: Average reward rate
definition: Rewards paid as a share of the money recovered (reward-eligible amount) over a period, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1.

name: Awards accrued (determined, not yet paid)
definition: Whistleblower awards the programme has recorded as probable liabilities (contingent claims accrued) or preliminarily determined in a period or at a date, before payment; breakdown item= says which (e.g. item=preliminary_determinations).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC fund table line 'contingent claims to Fund resources accrued'; needed so the fund table adds up).

name: Awards paid (amount)
definition: Total money paid to whistleblowers as awards in a period.

name: Awards paid (number)
definition: Number of awards paid (or made, if the source does not distinguish) in a period. Say in notes whether paid or merely determined.

name: Awards reduced for a negative factor
definition: Number of awards whose percentage a programme reduced in a period because of a negative factor (unreasonable reporting delay, culpability, interference with internal reporting); breakdown item= gives the reason.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports FY2021-FY2025).

name: Cases handled by a whistleblower authority
definition: Cases, files or matters a whistleblower protection authority dealt with in a period, as the source counts them (breakdown says scope, type or unit).
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (Slovak Whistleblower Protection Office reports).

name: Claimants barred for frivolous claims
definition: Individuals a programme permanently barred from applying for awards in a period (e.g. SEC bar after three or more frivolous award claims), as the source counts them.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports: 'barred five claimants ... in FY 2025').

name: Claims closed
definition: Whistleblower claims or tips closed in a period, for any reason (award, denial, rejection, no action).

name: Open claims (inventory)
definition: Whistleblower claims, submissions or taxpayers still open (not closed) at a date, as the source counts them (say in notes whether submissions, claim numbers or taxpayers).
notes: proposed by research:irs. Needed for the IRS backlog: annual reports print open-inventory tables by status. Unit says what is counted.

name: Claims referred for examination
definition: Whistleblower claims (or tips) that the agency sent to field examination or investigation in a period, as the source counts them.
notes: proposed by research:irs. IRS annual reports from FY2018 print receipts selected for referral to field examination (Table 2B), a measure of how many tips are actually acted on.

name: Days open claims have spent in their current status
definition: For claims still open at a date, the average, longest or shortest number of days spent in their current processing status (breakdown item= gives the status, stat= the measure), as printed by the source. Not the time to an award.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa7. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa7 (IRS annual reports FY2011-FY2013, tables of days in current status for open 7623(b) claims).

name: Money collected thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Taxes, sanctions, penalties or other money collected by the government in cases where a whistleblower's information was used, in a period.

name: Compliance inspections
definition: Inspections by a whistleblower authority of employers' compliance (internal reporting systems, treatment of whistleblowers) in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Document requests reviewed to protect whistleblower identity
definition: Requests to produce or share enforcement documents that a whistleblower office reviewed in a period to protect whistleblower confidentiality; breakdown requester= (enforcement_litigation, other_agencies) and scope= (all, involving_whistleblowers, identifying_information).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC annual reports from FY2017).

name: Employer requests to act against a protected whistleblower
definition: Employer requests for the authority's consent to a labour-law act against a protected whistleblower, decided or received in a period; breakdown gives outcome.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Fines imposed for breaching whistleblower law
definition: Fines imposed by a whistleblower authority on employers or persons for breaching whistleblower-protection law (amount, or count with unit fines); breakdown item= names the target when published.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Cases handled by the agency enforcing a reward law
definition: Cases or matters opened, closed or pending in a period at the agency or division that enforces a whistleblower reward law (e.g. a state attorney general's civil Medicaid fraud division under a state false claims act), counting all its cases, whistleblower-initiated or not; breakdown item= opened, closed, pending (or another status the source names).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa21. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa21 (Texas joint interagency coordination reports FY2015-FY2025: Civil Medicaid Fraud / Healthcare Program Enforcement Division cases opened, closed and pending). cases_handled is defined for whistleblower protection authorities, so not used.

name: Share of enforcement matters involving whistleblowers
definition: Share of an agency's enforcement matters (investigations or actions) that involve or originate with whistleblowers, as the source states it.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC FY2024 report: 'About 42% of the CFTC's enforcement matters involve whistleblowers').

name: People or calls contacting the authority
definition: People who contacted a whistleblower authority, or helpline calls (breakdown channel=helpline), in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Forecast Exchequer yield of a reward measure
definition: Official forecast of the extra net tax revenue a reward measure is expected to bring in a future year (e.g. a costing certified by a fiscal council). Always status projection.
notes: proposed by research:uk-europe. Proposed for the UK Budget 2025 costing of the Strengthened Reward Scheme.

name: Non-qui tam fraud matters opened
definition: New False Claims Act matters opened by the government itself (referrals and investigations not started by a whistleblower suit) in a period, as counted by the DOJ Civil Division ("New matters - non qui tam").
notes: proposed by research:false-claims-act. Context for qui_tam_suits_filed: shows what share of new FCA matters come from whistleblowers.

name: Balance of the reward fund
definition: Balance of a dedicated fund that pays awards (e.g. the SEC Investor Protection Fund) at a date.

name: Deposits into the reward fund
definition: Money deposited into or credited to a dedicated whistleblower reward fund (e.g. CFTC Customer Protection Fund, SEC Investor Protection Fund) in a period, from collected sanctions.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (CFTC FY2011 report, statutory report item).

name: Investment earnings of the reward fund
definition: Earnings on investments of a dedicated whistleblower reward fund in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority (CFTC FY2011 report, statutory report item).

name: Other payments from the reward fund
definition: Money paid or incurred from a dedicated whistleblower reward fund for purposes other than awards in a period (e.g. customer education, administrative expenses of the whistleblower office); breakdown item= says which, and whether paid or incurred but unpaid.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC Customer Protection Fund statutory table; needed so the fund table can be checked).

name: Individuals awarded
definition: Number of distinct individuals who received an award in a period or since launch.

name: Informant reward contracts signed
definition: Number of reward contracts or agreements the agency has signed with informants (cumulative or in a period).
notes: proposed by research:international. Canada CRA OTIP, where a reward requires a signed contract.

name: Proceedings opened on whistleblower information
definition: Investigations or proceedings an authority opened (or prepared to open) in a period on the basis of information from whistleblowers or informants; breakdown item= says which channel or programme.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-hun1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-hun1 (GVH 2016 report: 1 proceeding from the informant reward, 2 from Kartell Chat).

name: Refusals to open proceedings on whistleblower information
definition: Decisions in a period not to open an investigation or proceeding on information from whistleblowers; breakdown item= type of investigation.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-ltu1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-ltu1 (Lithuanian Prosecutor's Office: refusals to open a pre-trial investigation).

name: Share of eligible awards given the maximum-award presumption
definition: Share of eligible covered actions (where a maximum award would be small enough for the presumption to be considered) in which an agency applied its presumption of the statutory maximum award, in a period, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC FY2024 report: presumption applied about 90% of the time where the maximum award would be $5 million or less).

name: Notices of Covered Action posted
definition: Notices of Covered Action (NCAs) a programme posts in a period: enforcement actions whose sanctions pass the award threshold, opening a window for award claims (SEC/CFTC).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC annual reports print NCAs posted each year).

name: Status notices sent to whistleblowers
definition: Notices or letters a programme sent to whistleblowers about the progress of their claim in a period (e.g. IRS Taxpayer First Act notices: referral for audit, payment of tax, status and stage letters); breakdown item= says which.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa7. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa7 (IRS FY2021-FY2024 reports, Taxpayer First Act disclosure tables). The referral notices already in the data are filed under claims_referred_to_exam item=tfa_referral_notices; the main session may move them here.

name: Preliminary award recommendation letters issued
definition: Preliminary award recommendation letters (or similar preliminary award determinations) a programme issued to whistleblowers in a period, as counted by the source; a count, not money.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa7. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa7 (IRS FY2018 report: 268 PARLs issued; awards_accrued is for money).

name: Preliminary determinations on award claims
definition: Preliminary decisions a programme issued on award claims in a period, before the final order, as the source counts them; breakdown item= says which: award_recommended, denial_recommended, preliminary_summary_dispositions (summary preliminary denials) or all. Counts determinations or claims, not final orders.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports FY2020-FY2025: Preliminary Determinations recommending awards or denials, Preliminary Summary Dispositions). Overlaps preliminary_award_letters (IRS letters); the SEC award recommendations are filed here instead.

name: Time to decide a claim
definition: Average or median time from claim to award decision or payment, as the source defines it (say which in notes).

name: Cost of running a whistleblower programme
definition: Money spent or expected to be spent on administering a whistleblower programme (staff, IT, outreach) in a period, excluding the awards themselves; status budget or projection for plans and estimates.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (FinCEN NPRM 2026: $1.8 million first year, $1.6 million a year after; CBO estimates).

name: Staff of a whistleblower office
definition: People working in a whistleblower or award office at a date, or its authorised staffing level, as the source counts them; breakdown item= says which (start_of_year, end_of_year, analysts, permanent_staffing_level).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (IRS annual reports FY2008-FY2009 print Whistleblower Office staffing; GAO reports do too).

name: Protected whistleblower statuses granted
definition: Whistleblowers (or statuses) granted formal protected status in a period (e.g. Slovak 'status chráneného oznamovateľa').
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Enforcement actions to protect whistleblowers
definition: Enforcement actions an agency brought in a period or to date against entities or people for impeding whistleblowers from reporting (e.g. SEC Rule 21F-17, restrictive agreements) or for retaliating against them; breakdown item= (impeding, retaliation).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa9. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa9 (SEC annual reports FY2020-FY2024). The penalties themselves go in employer_fines_imposed.

name: Requests for protective measures
definition: Requests by whistleblowers for a protective measure (e.g. suspension of an employer's act, protected status) handled in a period; breakdown gives measure and outcome.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Whistleblowers given psychosocial or career support
definition: Whistleblowers who used support services (psychological, career) provided by an authority in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-wb-priority. proposed by extract-wb-priority.

name: Protective measures taken
definition: Protective measures an authority took for whistleblowers in a period (e.g. preventive measures before any retaliation), as the source counts them.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1 (ACRC 2011 report).

name: Public awareness of the whistleblower system
definition: Share of the public that knows of a whistleblower protection or reward system, from a survey, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1 (ACRC survey figures 2011-2020).

name: Qui tam lawsuits filed
definition: New False Claims Act (or similar) lawsuits filed by whistleblowers (relators) in a period.

name: Recoveries in cases not brought by whistleblowers
definition: Money recovered (settlements and judgments) in cases that did not originate in a whistleblower (qui tam) suit, in a period.
notes: proposed by research:false-claims-act. DOJ FCA table column "Settlements and judgments - non qui tam". Has a series break at FY2020 (U.S. Attorneys' Office matters added).

name: Share of recoveries by category
definition: Share of a programme's total recoveries (settlements and judgments) in a period that falls in a category (industry, agency, origin), as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa3. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa3 (DOJ FY2006 FCA release: 72% health care, 20% defence, 8% other).

name: State bonus share of Medicaid fraud recoveries
definition: Money from Medicaid false-claims recoveries that a US state keeps instead of returning it to the federal government because its own false claims act qualifies under section 1909 of the Social Security Act (an extra 10 percentage points of the federal share), in a period, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa8. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa8 (New York MFCU annual letters 2018-2020).

name: Total recoveries
definition: All money recovered by the government under the law in a period (settlements and judgments), whistleblower cases or not.

name: Recoveries in whistleblower cases
definition: Money recovered in cases brought or prompted by a whistleblower (qui tam), in a period.

name: Payments to relators
definition: Money paid or awarded to whistleblowers (relators) as their share of qui tam recoveries in a period.

name: Relief money paid to whistleblowers
definition: Money paid to whistleblowers to reimburse costs or damages caused by reporting (medical, relocation, litigation, lost wages), not a reward; amount (currency) or number of payments (unit cases).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-kor1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-kor1 (Korean 구조금).

name: Respondents sanctioned in whistleblower cases
definition: Number of respondents (persons or companies) against whom successful enforcement action was taken in matters where whistleblower information contributed, in a period or to date.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-can1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-can1 (OSC: '19 respondents'). Companion to sanctions_ordered.

name: Money authorised for paying rewards
definition: Money a law authorises or appropriates for paying whistleblower or informant rewards in a period (always status budget).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa2. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa2 (Kleptocracy Asset Recovery Rewards Act: $450,000 authorised for FY2021).

name: Sanctions ordered in whistleblower cases
definition: Monetary sanctions ordered (not necessarily collected) in enforcement actions that used whistleblower information.

name: Settlements and judgments (number)
definition: Number of settlements and judgments a programme obtained in a period (e.g. DOJ False Claims Act settlements and judgments), whistleblower cases or not; breakdown category= for a subset.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa4. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa4 (DOJ FCA releases from FY2022 print the number of settlements and judgments; companion to recoveries_total).

name: Supplemental submissions per supplemented tip
definition: Average number of supplemental submissions filed per original tip that was supplemented, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (FinCEN NPRM 2026 Table 4). Could instead be folded into a generic ratio indicator.

name: Taxes assessed thanks to whistleblowers
definition: Additional tax assessed (or identified as owing) in cases using informants' information, whether or not collected.
notes: proposed by research:international. Separate from collections_attributable (money actually collected).

name: Share of tips with a given feature
definition: Share of tips or submissions in a period that have a stated feature, as printed by the source; breakdown item= says which (e.g. supplemented_later, award_application_later, also_submitted_to_other_agencies).
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa6. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa6 (FinCEN NPRM 2026 Table 4 and text).

name: Countries tips came from
definition: Number of countries from which a programme received tips in a period or to date.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-can1. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-can1 (OSC: tips from 30 countries). SEC/CFTC annual reports print similar counts.

name: Whistleblower tips or submissions received
definition: Tips, submissions or claims received by the programme in a period, as the source counts them (say in notes whether by submission, by claim or by person).

name: Share of tips in a category
definition: Share of the tips, submissions or claims a programme received that fall in a category (e.g. not meeting a legal threshold, anonymous, from abroad), as printed by the source; breakdown item= says which.
notes: proposed by research:extract-whistleblowing-usa7. proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa7 (IRS FY2010 report: about 85 percent of submissions do not meet the 7623(b) thresholds).
